name: ai-capabilities-suite
description: AI Capability Extension Suite - Collection of independent MCP servers for AI agent capabilities

scripts.build:binaries: npm run build && npx ts-node scripts/build-binaries.ts
scripts.publish:debugger: npm run publish:core && npm run publish:server
scripts.publish:debugger:check: npm run build && npm run test && npm run publish:debugger
scripts.test:servers: echo "====  Debugger Core  ====" && cd packages/mcp-debugger-core && yarn test echo "====  Debugger Server  ====" && cd ../mcp-debugger-server && yarn test echo "====  Filesystem  ===="  && cd ../mcp-filesystem && yarn test && echo "====  Process  ====" && cd ../mcp-process && yarn test && echo "====  Screenshot  ====" && cd ../mcp-screenshot && yarn test
scripts.test:extensions: echo "====  Debugger  ====" && cd packages/vscode-mcp-debugger && yarn test && echo "====  Filesystem  ====" && cd ../vscode-mcp-acs-filesystem && yarn test && echo "====  Process  ====" && cd ../vscode-mcp-acs-process && yarn test && echo "====  Screenshot  ====" && cd ../vscode-mcp-screenshot && yarn test && echo "====  Verdaccio  ====" && cd ../vscode-mcp-acs-verdaccio && yarn test
